problem_statement: Koustubh Personal Website Template should become a credible developer portfolio kit while preserving its existing React single-page component structure. The repo already has a purple/white visual system, avatar-centered scroll navbar, Lottie-style animations, grouped skill icons, an education/experience timeline toggle, project cards, a local project screenshot, social icons, map embed, and contact form. In the captured site the structure is usable but the content is still template filler and the Selected Work grid is a flat list with no way to browse by track. Turn the existing hero, skills, background, projects, and contact sections into a polished portfolio credibility kit for a frontend/full-stack developer: give Selected Work a working track filter (All / Frontend / Backend / Data) with a live 'Showing N of M' result count that re-filters the project cards, expose case-study evidence (Role, Stack, Outcome) on every card, and surface an 'Available for work' credibility rail across the Skills, Projects, and Contact sections. Keep the one-page portfolio and local assets, replace the fake email/form endpoint with credible intake copy, and repair the mobile layout so the filter row and cards stay overflow-free and the fixed purple navbar does not cross through content.
required_content: Use the existing single-page surfaces and components; do not add a separate route, external portfolio template, or static screenshot mockup.
Replace Template Man and the dummy printing paragraph with concise developer positioning and credible summary text grounded in the existing frontend/backend/database/tooling skills.
Refine Skills so grouped icons become a readable toolkit with useful context such as primary stack, learning depth, project fit, or workflow role while preserving local icons and animations.
Refine Background so Education/Experience entries read as credible timeline evidence and keep the toggle interaction available.

Keep existing project links/social icons, avatar nav, map/contact layout, and contact form fields, but replace fake email/form endpoint/template comments with credible availability or project-intake copy.
Repair mobile presentation so fixed nav does not obscure important hero, project, or contact content and cards/forms remain readable at 390px.
Maintain the purple rounded-card visual language and avoid converting the site into a plain text resume or unrelated SaaS landing page.
Add a working Selected Work track filter (All / Frontend / Backend / Data) whose tabs re-filter the project cards and update a visible 'Showing N of M' result count as tracks are selected.

Surface an 'Available for work' credibility rail (role availability, recent shipping, core stack) inside the Skills, Projects, and Contact sections so the availability story is consistent across the page.
design_constraints: Preserve the purple/white personal-site identity: centered avatar nav, rounded purple skill cards, soft white project cards, purple timeline band, Lottie/animation assets, icon-based social links, and rounded contact panel.
The result should feel like one concise developer portfolio, not separate renamed sections or a generic resume dump.
Use existing local avatar, project screenshot, skill icons, social/contact icons, and animation JSON assets without distortion.
Project cards should expose role, stack, outcome, and evidence at scan speed; they should not rely only on hover-only text or empty gray boxes.
Mobile should keep the playful purple style but prevent the fixed navbar from covering hero/project/contact content.
Contact should provide credible availability and project-intake cues while keeping the existing form fields and Send action visible.
The Selected Work track filter must actually filter: clicking a track shows only that track's cards and the result count must reflect what is shown, not a frozen 'all' snapshot.
The track-filter tab row and project cards must stay readable and non-overlapping at 390px; tabs must never spill horizontally and cards must not shingle over each other.
state_constraints: desktop_initial anchors hero, avatar navbar, social icons, home animation, skills, background, projects, and contact in one long-page capture.
mobile_initial / mobile_hero / mobile_projects / tablet_projects are responsive states: the navbar must not cover hero content and the track-filter row plus cards must stay overflow-free.
desktop_skills verifies grouped skill cards, local icons, animations, and the Available-for-work rail in the Skills section.

desktop_projects verifies the Selected Work track filter, result count, project evidence cards (Case Study / Role / Outcome), screenshot use, technology tags, and the Available-for-work rail in the Projects section.
desktop_projects_filter is the interaction state: clicking the Frontend track tab must reduce the grid to the Frontend projects and update the count readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Frontend'.
desktop_contact verifies credible contact copy, email/social evidence, form fields, Send button, map area, and the Available-for-work rail in the Contact section.
New labels such as Selected Work, Case Study, Role, Stack, Outcome, Filter by track, Available for work, Frontend, Full-Stack, or Live Demo should be real DOM text where used.

change_completion: Hero, skills, background, projects, and contact sections become a credible developer portfolio rather than template filler.
The Selected Work track filter re-filters the project cards and the 'Showing N of M' count reflects the selected track.
Projects expose concrete case-study evidence (Role, Stack, Outcome) and the Available-for-work rail appears across Skills, Projects, and Contact.
Contact keeps email/form functionality while replacing the fake endpoint/email with credible intake/availability copy.
design_consistency: Purple/white visual system, avatar nav, rounded cards, iconography, animations, and map/contact layout remain recognizable.
The track filter and availability rail fit the compact portfolio style and do not become a dense corporate resume page.
Existing local assets are crisp and semantically paired with nearby text.
regression: Navbar scroll links, Skills, Background education/experience toggle, Projects, Contact form fields, social icons, project links, and map remain present.
No broken images, missing animation areas, raw placeholder copy, loading-only page, or removed section is introduced.
Desktop single-page ordering remains Home, Skills, Background, Projects, Contact.
responsive: 390px mobile states remain overflow-free and the fixed nav no longer covers important hero/project/contact content.
The track-filter tab row and mobile project/skill cards stay readable without clipped labels, tiny icons, or horizontal spill.
Contact form and map/contact proof stack cleanly on mobile.

author_notes: Repo-grounded React (CRA) portfolio component task on the KoustubhSahu Personal-Website-Template. The single-page site already ships a purple/white avatar nav, Lottie-style animation JSON assets, grouped skill icons, a timeline toggle, project cards with a local screenshot asset, social icons, and a contact form. The L4 upgrade adds a genuinely interactive native lever inside the existing Selected Work grid — a track filter (All / Frontend / Backend / Data) with a live result count — plus an Available-for-work credibility rail shared across the Skills, Projects, and Contact sections. The task stays inside the existing components; it does not add a route or swap the theme.
